raw.body:
docs(site): update version claims and test count for v0.4.0

The landing page still described the runtime as Arazzo 1.0.1 in the meta descriptions, JSON-LD, hero badge, and how-it-works copy, claimed a full 1.0.1 expression surface, counted 531 tests, and pointed the download command at v0.3.0. All claims now match the released tree: version-free executor description, Arazzo 1.1.0 badge, 931 hermetic tests with extensions and gaps labeled, v0.4.0 download.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
